plugin.name: Plugin_Debugger
plugin.author: Crowley
plugin.purpose: A cleaner Trace: what fires, who called it, and what line led to a command being sent
plugin.description:
Plugin Debugger: reads the Trace output (no changes needed in any plugin) and prints a cleaned-up version in the world window.
dbg on / dbg off start / stop (this switches MUSHclient's trace on and off for you) dbg help the commands, with examples, in the world window dbg options the current settings dbg window a window: tick the plugins and the kinds of line you want to watch
Short version: dbg watch triggers aliases only those types dbg watch MyPlugin only that plugin dbg watch stock only the Aardwolf package's own plugins dbg ignore calls callbacks hide whole types dbg summary who called what, how often, last 10 seconds dbg log on keep a file of what is watched
Every command sent to the world (typed, from an alias, a trigger or a script) is shown as SENT "text" together with what came right before it: the trigger or alias lines from the trace and the last line the game sent. "I never typed stop, why is it sent?" ends up as SENT "stop" <- the line that matched. Repeated lines in a burst are collapsed into "x12".
Every line starts with [dbg] and a coloured [type] tag: [trigger] [alias] [timer] [call] [callback] [broadcast] [script] [sent] [other] (the same words dbg watch and dbg ignore use). What they mean: call one plugin calling a function in another one with CallPlugin: caller -> plugin: function(arguments) callback a function MUSHclient itself runs in a plugin when something happens in the client (names that start with On: OnPluginLineReceived for every line, OnPluginBroadcast, OnPluginSent, OnPluginPacketReceived ...) trigger / alias / timer a match, shown with the script it ran: plugin: trigger "pattern" -> script("the line") broadcast a plugin announcing something to all the others with BroadcastPlugin (GMCP data, "dock_ready" ...); the plugins that listen then show up as callbacks (OnPluginBroadcast) script a script function run by something the debugger did not see the start of sent a command sent to the world; the "before" lines under it are the matches that led to it

muclient.script:
local on, quiet, logging = false, false, false local watch, ignore, types, itypes, groups, igroups = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {} local ring, RING_MAX = {}, 3000 local queue, flushing = {}, false local recent = {} -- the last trace lines that are not plain function calls (trigger/alias matches, sends ...) local lastLine = nil -- the last line the game sent: { text, t } local got, lastShown = 0, nil local logfile local pick = nil -- plugins ticked in the options window: nil = every plugin, else a set of lower case names ("(world)" = the world's own scripts)
local NOISE = { "windowtext", "windowrectop", "windowline", "windowshow", "windowposition", "windowcreate", "windowcircleop", "windowgradient", "windowfont", "windowinfo", "windowhotspot", "windowaddhotspot", "windowmovehotspot", "redraw", "bufferedrepaint", "windowdelete" }
local function say(s) ColourNote("silver", "", "[dbg] " .. s) end local function now() return os.time() end
function OnPluginSaveState() SetVariable("watch", table.concat(watch, ",")) SetVariable("ignore", table.concat(ignore, ",")) SetVariable("types", table.concat(types, ",")) SetVariable("itypes", table.concat(itypes, ",")) SetVariable("groups", table.concat(groups, ",")) SetVariable("igroups", table.concat(igroups, ",")) local pl = {} for k in pairs(pick or {}) do pl[#pl + 1] = k end table.sort(pl) SetVariable("pick", table.concat(pl, "\t")); SetVariable("picked", pick and "1" or "0") SetVariable("logging", logging and "1" or "0") SetVariable("quiet", quiet and "1" or "0") end local function loadList(name) local t = {} for w in (GetVariable(name) or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do t[#t + 1] = w end return t end
local noiseOn = {} -- noise words let through for now (never saved: every load starts with them hidden) local function isNoise(l) l = l:lower() for _, w in ipairs(NOISE) do if l:find(w, 1, true) and not noiseOn[w] then return true end end return false end local TYPE_WORDS = { trigger = "trigger", triggers = "trigger", alias = "alias", aliases = "alias", timer = "timer", timers = "timer", call = "call", calls = "call", callback = "callback", callbacks = "callback", script = "script", scripts = "script", broadcast = "broadcast", broadcasts = "broadcast", sent = "sent", other = "other", others = "other" } local function typeSet() local t = {}; for _, w in ipairs(types) do t[w] = true end; return t end -- "stock" = the plugins the Aardwolf package's world file (Aardwolf.mcl) includes. They are matched by file name, wherever the file sits. local STOCK_FILES = {} for f in ([[aard_requirements.xml aard_text_substitution.xml aard_prompt_fixer.xml aard_chat_echo.xml aard_channels_fiendish.xml aard_soundpack.xml aard_GMCP_handler.xml aard_miniwindow_z_order_monitor.xml aard_layout.xml aard_statmon_gmcp.xml aard_group_monitor_gmcp.xml aard_health_bars_gmcp.xml aard_Copy_Colour_Codes.xml aard_ASCII_map.xml aard_repaint_buffer.xml aard_new_connection.xml aard_inventory_serials.xml Hyperlink_URL2.xml aard_GMCP_mapper.xml aard_package_update_checker.xml aard_help.xml aard_keyboard_lockout.xml aard_splitscreen_scrollback.xml aard_vital_shortcuts.xml aard_Theme_Controller.xml aard_ingame_help_window.xml Automatic_Backup.xml]]):gmatch("%S+") do STOCK_FILES[f:lower()] = true end local GROUP_WORDS = { stock = "stock", thirdparty = "thirdparty", ["third-party"] = "thirdparty", ["3rdparty"] = "thirdparty" } local stockCache = nil local function fileOf(id) return ((GetPluginInfo(id, 6) or ""):match("[^/\\]+$") or ""):lower() end local function buildStock() stockCache = {} for _, id in ipairs(GetPluginList() or {}) do local name = GetPluginInfo(id, 1) if name then stockCache[name] = STOCK_FILES[fileOf(id)] == true end end end local function isStock(name) if not stockCache or stockCache[name] == nil then buildStock() end return stockCache[name] == true end local function inGroups(list, ...) for _, plugin in ipairs({ ... }) do if plugin and plugin ~= "" then local st = isStock(plugin) for _, g in ipairs(list) do if (g == "stock" and st) or (g == "thirdparty" and not st) then return true end end end end return false end
local function pickHas(...) for _, p in ipairs({ ... }) do if p and p ~= "" and pick[p:lower()] then return true end end return false end
local function wanted(text, kind, plugin, from) local l = text:lower() for _, w in ipairs(itypes) do if w == kind then return false end end for _, w in ipairs(ignore) do if l:find(w, 1, true) then return false end end if #igroups > 0 and inGroups(igroups, plugin, from) then return false end if #types > 0 then local ok = false for _, w in ipairs(types) do if w == kind then ok = true end end if not ok then return false end end if #watch == 0 and #groups == 0 and not pick then return true end for _, w in ipairs(watch) do if l:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end if #groups > 0 and inGroups(groups, plugin, from) then return true end if pick then if kind == "sent" or pickHas(plugin, from) then return true end -- a sent command is chosen with the types, not with the plugins if (not plugin or plugin == "") and #watch == 0 and pick["(world)"] then return true end return false end if #watch == 0 and (not plugin or plugin == "") then return true end -- lines that belong to no plugin (sent commands ...) pass a group-only filter return false end
local function depthOf(msg, marker) local pre = msg:match("^(.-)" .. marker) or "" return math.floor(math.max(0, #(pre:match("(%s*)$") or "") - 1) / 2) end local function tidyArgs(a) a = a:gsub(", <table>", ""):gsub('^"%*[%w_]+", ', "") return a end local function parse(msg) local plug, fn, from = msg:match('Plugin "(.-)": Function: (.-) %[CallPlugin from "(.-)"%]') if plug then local depth = depthOf(msg, 'Plugin "') return { kind = "call", plugin = plug, fn = fn, from = from, depth = depth, s = string.rep(" ", depth) .. from .. " -> " .. plug .. ": " .. fn, key = from .. " -> " .. plug .. "." .. (fn:match("^[^(]+") or fn) } end local bplug, bargs = msg:match('Plugin "(.-)": BroadcastPlugin%((.*)%)') if bplug then local depth = depthOf(msg, 'Plugin "') return { kind = "broadcast", plugin = bplug, depth = depth, s = string.rep(" ", depth) .. bplug .. ": BroadcastPlugin(" .. bargs .. ")", key = bplug .. " broadcast " .. (bargs:match("^[^,]*") or "") } end plug, fn = msg:match('Plugin "(.-)": Function: (.+)$') if plug then local depth = depthOf(msg, 'Plugin "') local name = fn:match("^[^(]+") or fn local kind = name:match("^On%u") and "callback" or "script" return { kind = kind, plugin = plug, fn = fn, depth = depth, s = string.rep(" ", depth) .. plug .. ": " .. fn, key = plug .. "." .. name } end if not msg:find('Plugin "', 1, true) then -- the world's own (not a plugin's) scripts: "Function: retreat(...)" fn = msg:match("Function: (.+)$") if fn then local depth = depthOf(msg, "Function:") local name = fn:match("^[^(]+") or fn return { kind = name:match("^On%u") and "callback" or "script", plugin = "", fn = fn, depth = depth, s = string.rep(" ", depth) .. "world: " .. fn, key = "world." .. name } end end local what, label plug, what, label = msg:match('Plugin "(.-)": Matched (%a+) (.+)$') if not plug then what, label = msg:match("Matched (%a+) (.+)$") end if what and (what:lower() == "trigger" or what:lower() == "alias" or what:lower() == "timer") then what = what:lower() return { kind = what, plugin = plug or "", match = true, label = label, s = (plug and (plug .. ": ") or "") .. what .. " " .. label, key = (plug or "world") .. " " .. what .. " " .. label:sub(1, 50) } end plug, label = msg:match('Plugin "(.-)": Fired (.+)$') if not plug then label = msg:match("^%s*.-Fired (.+timer.+)$") end if label then label = label:gsub("^unlabelled timer ", "(unlabelled) "):gsub("^timer ", "") return { kind = "timer", plugin = plug or "", match = true, label = label, s = (plug and (plug .. ": ") or "") .. "timer " .. label, key = (plug or "world") .. " timer " .. label:sub(1, 40) } end local text = msg:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") return { kind = "other", s = text, key = text:sub(1, 60) } end
local LOG_MAX = 5 * 1024 * 1024 -- when the log reaches this size it becomes plugin_debugger.old.log (one old copy is kept) local logSize = 0 local function logLine(s) if not logging then return end local path = (GetInfo(66) or "") .. "plugin_debugger.log" if not logfile then logfile = io.open(path, "a") if logfile then logSize = logfile:seek("end") or 0 end end if not logfile then return end local line = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ") .. s .. "\n" logfile:write(line); logfile:flush(); logSize = logSize + #line if logSize > LOG_MAX then logfile:close(); logfile = nil; logSize = 0 local old = (GetInfo(66) or "") .. "plugin_debugger.old.log" os.remove(old); os.rename(path, old) end end
-- every line starts with [dbg] and a coloured [type] tag, the same words "dbg watch" and "dbg ignore" understand local TAG = { trigger = "lime", alias = "deepskyblue", timer = "violet", call = "cyan", callback = "gray", broadcast = "gold", script = "mediumseagreen", sent = "yellow", other = "orange", ctx = "gray" } local TAGNAME = { ctx = "before" } local function flush() flushing = false local i = 1 while i <= #queue do local q, n = queue[i], 1 while queue[i + n] and queue[i + n].s == q.s do n = n + 1 end local body = q.s .. (n > 1 and (" x" .. n) or "") local colour = TAG[q.kind] or "silver" ColourNote("gray", "", "[dbg] ", colour, "", "[" .. (TAGNAME[q.kind] or q.kind) .. "] ", q.kind == "sent" and "yellow" or "silver", "", body) i = i + n end queue = {} end local function show(kind, s) queue[#queue + 1] = { kind = kind, s = s } if not flushing then flushing = true; DoAfterSpecial(0.4, "dbg_flush()", 12) end end function dbg_flush() flush() end
local function addRing(ev) ring[#ring + 1] = ev if #ring > RING_MAX then table.remove(ring, 1) end end
local pend = nil -- a trigger/alias/timer match waiting for the script it ran local function commit(ev) ev.t = ev.t or now() addRing(ev) if ev.kind ~= "call" and ev.kind ~= "callback" then recent[#recent + 1] = ev if #recent > 12 then table.remove(recent, 1) end end if wanted(ev.s, ev.kind, ev.plugin, ev.from) then show(ev.kind, ev.s); logLine(ev.s) end -- the log follows the same watch / ignore rules as the screen end local function flushPend() if pend then local p = pend; pend = nil; commit(p) end end local function event(ev) if pend then if ev.kind == "script" and ev.plugin == pend.plugin then -- the script that match ran: one line for both local p = pend; pend = nil local name = ev.fn:match("^[^(]+") or ev.fn local args = ev.fn:match("%((.*)%)$") or "" p.s = p.s .. " -> " .. name .. "(" .. tidyArgs(args) .. ")" p.key = p.key commit(p) return end flushPend() end if ev.match then pend = ev; DoAfterSpecial(0.3, "dbg_flushpend()", 12); return end commit(ev) end function dbg_flushpend() flushPend() end
-- plugin callbacks ------------------------------------------------------------------------- function OnPluginTrace(msg) if not on then return end got = got + 1 if type(msg) ~= "string" or msg == "" or msg:find("Trace off", 1, true) or msg:find("Trace on", 1, true) then return end if isNoise(msg) then return end event(parse(msg)) if quiet then return false end end
function OnPluginLineReceived(text) if on then lastLine = { text = text, t = now() } end return true end
function OnPluginSent(text) if not on or not text then return end flushPend() local line = text:gsub("[\r\n]+$", "") if not wanted(line, "sent") then return end local t = now() local ev = { kind = "sent", t = t, s = 'SENT "' .. line .. '"', key = "sent" } addRing(ev) show("sent", ev.s); logLine(ev.s) local first = math.max(1, #recent - 4) -- the last few matches, at most for i = first, #recent do local r = recent[i]; if t - r.t <= 1 then show("ctx", r.s) end end if lastLine and t - lastLine.t <= 1 then show("ctx", 'last line from the game: "' .. lastLine.text:sub(1, 120) .. '"') end end
-- command ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ local function listHas(t, w) for i, v in ipairs(t) do if v == w then return i end end end
local function startTrace() on = true; got = 0 SetTrace(true) say("on. Trace lines are read here" .. (quiet and " and kept out of the Trace window." or ".")) end local function stopTrace() flush(); on = false SetTrace(false) say("off.") end
local function summary(secs) flushPend() local limit, counts, order = now() - secs, {}, {} for _, ev in ipairs(ring) do if ev.t >= limit and ev.kind ~= "sent" then if not counts[ev.key] then counts[ev.key] = 0; order[#order + 1] = ev.key end counts[ev.key] = counts[ev.key] + 1 end end table.sort(order, function(a, b) return counts[a] > counts[b] end) if #order == 0 then say("Nothing in the last " .. secs .. " seconds.") return end say("last " .. secs .. " seconds:") for i = 1, math.min(15, #order) do ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %5d (%.1f/s) %s", counts[order[i]], counts[order[i]] / secs, order[i])) end end
local function typesText() return #types == 0 and "every type" or (types[1] == "none" and "no type" or table.concat(types, ", ")) end local function whereText() local w = {} if pick then local n = 0 for _ in pairs(pick) do n = n + 1 end w[#w + 1] = n == 0 and "no plugin picked" or (n .. " picked plugin" .. (n == 1 and "" or "s") .. " (dbg window)") end for _, g in ipairs(groups) do w[#w + 1] = (g == "stock" and "stock plugins" or "third-party plugins") end for _, x in ipairs(watch) do w[#w + 1] = x end return #w > 0 and table.concat(w, ", ") or "every plugin" end local function watchText() return "watching " .. typesText() .. " in " .. whereText() .. "." end local function ignoreText() local all = {} for _, w in ipairs(itypes) do all[#all + 1] = w .. " (type)" end for _, g in ipairs(igroups) do all[#all + 1] = (g == "stock" and "stock plugins" or "third-party plugins") end for _, w in ipairs(ignore) do all[#all + 1] = w end return "ignoring: " .. (#all > 0 and table.concat(all, ", ") or "(nothing)") .. "." end
local function row(cmd, desc) ColourNote("cyan", "", string.format(" %-36s", cmd), "silver", "", desc) end local function head(t) ColourNote("white", "", t) end local function plain(t) ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. t) end
function dbg_help() head("Plugin Debugger: shows what fires in your plugins, without changing them") head("Start and stop") row("dbg on / dbg off", "start or stop (this turns MUSHclient's trace on and off too)") row("dbg options", "show the current settings") head("Choose what you see") row("dbg window", "a window with a box for every plugin and every kind of line (All / None buttons for each)") row("dbg watch triggers aliases", "show only those types (in every plugin)") row("dbg watch GMCP_handler", "show only lines from that plugin (any type)") row("dbg watch GMCP_handler triggers", "that plugin, those types: plugin names and types mix freely") row("dbg watch stock", "only the plugins that come with the Aardwolf package (good for client bugs; the list is the package's world file)") row("dbg watch thirdparty", "only your own and other add-on plugins. 'dbg stock' lists which ones count as stock") row("dbg watch all / dbg watch clear", "show everything again") row("dbg ignore calls callbacks", "hide whole types") row("dbg ignore stock", "hide a whole group (stock or thirdparty)") row("dbg ignore gmcpdata", "hide any line containing that text") row("dbg noise windowrectop", "let one kind of hidden window-drawing line through (dbg noise all for every kind, dbg noise off to hide them again; not remembered)") row("dbg unwatch WORD / dbg unignore WORD", "take one word back out; dbg ignore clear removes all ignores") head("Look back") row("dbg summary [seconds]", "who called what, and how often (default: the last 10 seconds). Finds runaway calls") row("dbg last [number]", "the last events, even ones the live view did not show (default 30)") head("Record") row("dbg log on / dbg log off", "write what you are watching to plugin_debugger.log (in the logs folder, 5 MB then rolls over)") row("dbg quiet on / dbg quiet off", "keep trace lines out of the Trace window while this runs") head("The tags in front of each line") local list = { { "trigger", "a trigger matched; shown with the script it ran" }, { "alias", "an alias matched; shown with its script" }, { "timer", "a timer fired; shown with its script" }, { "call", "one plugin called a function in another (CallPlugin)" }, { "callback", "MUSHclient ran a plugin function (OnPluginLineReceived, OnPluginSent ...)" }, { "broadcast", "a plugin announced something to all the others (BroadcastPlugin)" }, { "script", "a script function whose trigger/alias/timer line was not seen" }, { "sent", "a command was sent to the game, with the matches just before it" }, { "other", "anything else" }, } for _, t in ipairs(list) do ColourNote(TAG[t[1]], "", string.format(" %-12s", "[" .. t[1] .. "]"), "silver", "", t[2]) end plain("Use the type names (plural works: triggers, calls ...) and the group names (stock, thirdparty) with watch and ignore.") end
function dbg_options() local function line(label, value, colour) ColourNote("silver", "", string.format(" %-18s", label), colour or "white", "", value) end head("Plugin Debugger options") line("Debugger", on and "ON" or "off", on and "lime" or "gray") line("Trace lines seen", tostring(got) .. (on and got == 0 and " (none yet: check that nothing else is taking them)" or "")) line("Watching", typesText() .. " in " .. whereText()) local ign = {} for _, w in ipairs(itypes) do ign[#ign + 1] = w end for _, g in ipairs(igroups) do ign[#ign + 1] = (g == "stock" and "stock plugins" or "third-party plugins") end for _, w in ipairs(ignore) do ign[#ign + 1] = '"' .. w .. '"' end line("Ignoring", #ign > 0 and table.concat(ign, ", ") or "nothing") line("Log file", logging and "ON (plugin_debugger.log in the logs folder, only what is watched)" or "off", logging and "lime" or "gray") line("Quiet", quiet and "ON (trace lines are kept out of the Trace window)" or "off", quiet and "lime" or "gray") local nz = {} for _, w in ipairs(NOISE) do if noiseOn[w] then nz[#nz + 1] = w end end line("Noise let through", #nz > 0 and table.concat(nz, ", ") or "none (window drawing lines are hidden; dbg noise WORD shows one)", #nz > 0 and "orange" or nil) line("Events kept", tostring(#ring) .. " (see them with dbg last or dbg summary)") plain("Change them with: dbg window (tick boxes) / dbg watch / dbg ignore / dbg log / dbg quiet (dbg help lists everything)") end
-- the options window: a box for every plugin and every kind of line -------------------------------------- -- It edits the same settings as dbg watch: the plugin boxes become the "pick" set, the kind boxes the "types" list. DbgTest = {} local ok_theme = pcall(require, "themed_miniwindows") local ok_sb = pcall(require, "scrollbar") -- the package's scroll bar local WIN = "PluginDebuggerOptions" local WORLD = "(world)" local W = { top = 0, added = {}, names = {}, sb = nil, win = nil, KINDS = { "trigger", "alias", "timer", "call", "callback", "broadcast", "script", "sent", "other" }, DESC = { trigger = "a trigger matched", alias = "an alias matched", timer = "a timer fired", call = "one plugin called another", callback = "the client ran a plugin function", broadcast = "a plugin announced something to all", script = "a script function ran", sent = "a command was sent to the game", other = "anything else" } } DbgTest.W = W
function W.palette() local bg, tt = Theme.PRIMARY_BODY, Theme.BODY_TEXT local function sp(c) return c % 256, math.floor(c / 256) % 256, math.floor(c / 65536) % 256 end local function rgb(r, g, b) return r + g * 256 + b * 65536 end local function mix(c1, c2, t) local r1, g1, b1 = sp(c1); local r2, g2, b2 = sp(c2) return rgb(math.floor(r1 + (r2 - r1) * t), math.floor(g1 + (g2 - g1) * t), math.floor(b1 + (b2 - b1) * t)) end local function lum(c) local r, g, b = sp(c); return 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b end local tx = mix(tt, lum(tt) >= lum(bg) and rgb(255, 255, 255) or rgb(0, 0, 0), 0.3) return { bg = bg, text = tx, muted = mix(tx, bg, 0.25), panel = mix(bg, tx, 0.09), edge = mix(bg, tx, 0.24), sel = mix(bg, rgb(70, 130, 230), 0.35), idle = rgb(90, 150, 240), on = rgb(70, 190, 105), warn = rgb(235, 165, 60) } end
function W.list() -- "(world)" first, then every loaded plugin by name local names, seen = {}, {} for _, id in ipairs(GetPluginList() or {}) do local n = GetPluginInfo(id, 1) if n and n ~= "" and not seen[n:lower()] then seen[n:lower()] = true; names[#names + 1] = n end end table.sort(names, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end) table.insert(names, 1, WORLD) return names end
function W.shown(name) -- would a line of this plugin be shown by the rules as they are now? local l = name:lower() if pick then return pick[l] == true end if name == WORLD then return #watch == 0 end if #watch == 0 and #groups == 0 then return true end for _, w in ipairs(watch) do if l:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end return #groups > 0 and inGroups(groups, name) end function W.kind_shown(k) return #types == 0 or listHas(types, k) ~= nil end
local function clear(t) for i = #t, 1, -1 do t[i] = nil end end
function W.toggle_plugin(name) local names = W.list() if not pick then -- rules typed as commands become a plain selection first (what the list shows) local p = {} for _, n in ipairs(names) do if W.shown(n) then p[n:lower()] = true end end pick = p clear(watch); clear(groups) end local l = name:lower() if pick[l] then pick[l] = nil else pick[l] = true end for _, n in ipairs(names) do if not pick[n:lower()] then return end end pick = nil -- everything ticked: back to "every plugin", so a plugin loaded later is watched too end
function W.toggle_kind(k) local cur = {} for _, x in ipairs(#types == 0 and W.KINDS or types) do cur[x] = true end cur.none = nil if cur[k] then cur[k] = nil else cur[k] = true end clear(types) local n = 0 for _, x in ipairs(W.KINDS) do if cur[x] then types[#types + 1] = x; n = n + 1 end end if n == #W.KINDS then clear(types) elseif n == 0 then types[1] = "none" end end
function W.repaint() if BufferedRepaint then BufferedRepaint() elseif IsPluginInstalled("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc") then CallPlugin("abc1a0944ae4af7586ce88dc", "BufferedRepaint") else Redraw() end end
function W.draw() local win = W.win if not win or not win.bodyleft then return end local fname, fsize = GetAlphaOption("output_font_name"), GetOption("output_font_height") WindowFont(WIN, "dw_f", fname, fsize, false); WindowFont(WIN, "dw_fb", fname, fsize, true); WindowFont(WIN, "dw_fs", fname, math.max(7, fsize - 1), false) local lh = WindowFontInfo(WIN, "dw_f", 1) + 1 local PAD = 8 local P = W.palette() for id in pairs(W.added) do WindowDeleteHotspot(WIN, id) end W.added = {} win:blank() local L, T, R, B = win.bodyleft, win.bodytop, win.bodyright, win.bodybottom local function tw(font, s) return WindowTextWidth(WIN, font, s) end local function tx(font, s, x, y, col) return WindowText(WIN, font, s, x, y, 0, 0, col, false) end local function fitw(font, s, maxw) if maxw <= 0 then return "" end if tw(font, s) <= maxw then return s end while #s > 1 and tw(font, s .. "...") > maxw do s = s:sub(1, -2) end return s .. "..." end local function pill(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill, edge) WindowCircleOp(WIN, 3, x1, y1, x2, y2, edge or fill, 0, 1, fill, 0, 8, 8) end local function hs(id, x1, y1, x2, y2, tip, wheel) if WindowMoveHotspot(WIN, id, x1, y1, x2, y2) ~= 0 then WindowAddHotspot(WIN, id, x1, y1, x2, y2, "", "", "", "", "DBG_click", tip or "", 1, 0) if wheel then WindowScrollwheelHandler(WIN, id, "DBG_wheel") end end W.added[id] = true end local function box(x, y, size, ticked) WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, x, y, x + size, y + size, ticked and P.idle or P.bg) WindowRectOp(WIN, 1, x, y, x + size, y + size, P.edge) if ticked then tx("dw_fs", "x", x + 3, y - 1, P.text) end end local names = W.list() W.names = names local np, nt = 0, 0 for _, n in ipairs(names) do if W.shown(n) then np = np + 1 end end for _, k in ipairs(W.KINDS) do if W.kind_shown(k) then nt = nt + 1 end end
-- top bar: the on/off button and a one-line summary local barH = lh + 12 local label = on and "Debugger ON" or "Debugger off" local bw = tw("dw_fs", label) + 16 pill(L + PAD, T + 5, L + PAD + bw, T + 3 + lh + 4, P.panel, on and P.on or P.edge) tx("dw_fs", label, L + PAD + 8, T + 7, on and P.on or P.muted) hs("a_toggle", L + PAD, T + 5, L + PAD + bw, T + 3 + lh + 4, on and "Click to stop the debugger" or "Click to start the debugger") local sx = L + PAD * 2 + bw tx("dw_fs", fitw("dw_fs", "watching " .. np .. " of " .. #names .. " plugins, " .. nt .. " of " .. #W.KINDS .. " kinds of line", R - sx - PAD), sx, T + 7, P.muted) WindowLine(WIN, L, T + barH, R, T + barH, P.edge, 0, 1)
-- geometry: plugins on the left, kinds of line on the right local midX = L + math.floor((R - L + 1) * 0.58) local hdrTop = T + barH + 1 local hdrH = lh + 10 local footH = lh + 10 local listTop, listBottom = hdrTop + hdrH + 1, B - footH WindowLine(WIN, midX, T + barH, midX, listBottom, P.edge, 0, 1) WindowLine(WIN, L, hdrTop + hdrH, R, hdrTop + hdrH, P.edge, 0, 1) WindowLine(WIN, L, listBottom, R, listBottom, P.edge, 0, 1) local function colhead(x1, x2, title, idAll, idNone) local rx = x2 - PAD for _, b in ipairs({ { idNone, "None", "Untick all, then tick the few you want" }, { idAll, "All", "Tick all" } }) do local w = tw("dw_fs", b[2]) + 14 if rx - w > x1 + 60 then pill(rx - w, hdrTop + 3, rx, hdrTop + hdrH - 4, P.panel, P.edge); tx("dw_fs", b[2], rx - w + 7, hdrTop + 5, P.text) hs(b[1], rx - w, hdrTop + 3, rx, hdrTop + hdrH - 4, b[3]) rx = rx - w - 5 end end tx("dw_fb", fitw("dw_fb", title, rx - x1 - PAD), x1 + PAD, hdrTop + 5, P.text) end colhead(L, midX - 1, "Plugins", "p_all", "p_none") colhead(midX + 1, R, "Kinds of line", "t_all", "t_none")
-- plugin list (scrolls) local rowH = lh + 8 local visible = math.max(1, math.floor((listBottom - listTop) / rowH)) local maxTop = math.max(0, #names - visible) if W.top > maxTop then W.top = maxTop end if W.top < 0 then W.top = 0 end local sbw = ok_sb and ((Theme.RESIZER_SIZE or 14)) or 0 local RR = midX - 1 - sbw - (sbw > 0 and 1 or 0) for i = 1, visible do local n = W.top + i local name = names[n] if not name then break end local y1 = listTop + (i - 1) * rowH local y2 = y1 + rowH - 1 local ticked = W.shown(name) if ticked then WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, L, y1, RR, y2, P.sel) elseif i % 2 == 0 then WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, L, y1, RR, y2, P.panel) end box(L + PAD, y1 + 4, lh - 4, ticked) local x0 = L + PAD + lh + 4 local text, note = name, nil if name == WORLD then note = "your own scripts and the world file" elseif isStock(name) then note = "stock" end local nameW = tw("dw_f", fitw("dw_f", text, RR - PAD - x0)) tx("dw_f", fitw("dw_f", text, RR - PAD - x0), x0, y1 + 4, ticked and P.text or P.muted) if note and RR - PAD - (x0 + nameW + 8) > 20 then tx("dw_fs", fitw("dw_fs", note, RR - PAD - (x0 + nameW + 8)), x0 + nameW + 8, y1 + 5, P.muted) end hs("p_row" .. n, L, y1, RR, y2, name == WORLD and "Lines that belong to no plugin: your world file's own triggers, aliases and scripts" or name, true) end hs("p_zlist", L, listTop, midX - 1, listBottom, "", true) -- named to sort after the rows: hotspots are tried in name order if ok_sb then if not W.sb then W.sb = ScrollBar.new(WIN, "pdbg", midX - sbw, listTop, midX - 1, listBottom) W.sb:addUpdateCallback(nil, function(step) W.top = math.max(0, (tonumber(step) or 1) - 1); W.safedraw() end) end W.sb:setRect(midX - sbw, listTop, midX - 1, listBottom) W.sb:setScroll(W.top + 1, visible, math.max(#names, visible), true) W.sb:draw(true) end
-- kinds of line for i, k in ipairs(W.KINDS) do local y1 = listTop + (i - 1) * rowH local y2 = y1 + rowH - 1 if y2 > listBottom then break end local ticked = W.kind_shown(k) if ticked then WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, midX + 1, y1, R, y2, P.sel) elseif i % 2 == 0 then WindowRectOp(WIN, 2, midX + 1, y1, R, y2, P.panel) end box(midX + 1 + PAD, y1 + 4, lh - 4, ticked) local x0 = midX + 1 + PAD + lh + 4 local colour = ColourNameToRGB and ColourNameToRGB(TAG[k] or "silver") or P.text local tag = "[" .. k .. "]" tx("dw_f", tag, x0, y1 + 4, ticked and colour or P.muted) local dx = x0 + tw("dw_f", tag) + 8 if R - PAD - dx > 20 then tx("dw_fs", fitw("dw_fs", W.DESC[k], R - PAD - dx), dx, y1 + 5, P.muted) end hs("t_row" .. i, midX + 1, y1, R, y2, W.DESC[k], false) end
-- footer local msg = "Click a box to watch or skip it. None, then tick a few, shows just those." if #itypes + #igroups + #ignore > 0 then msg = (ignoreText():gsub("^ignoring", "Also ignoring")) .. " (dbg ignore clear removes them)" end tx("dw_fs", fitw("dw_fs", msg, R - L - 2 * PAD), L + PAD, listBottom + 5, (#itypes + #igroups + #ignore > 0) and P.warn or P.muted) win:dress_window("Plugin Debugger") end
function W.safedraw() local ok, err = pcall(W.draw) if not ok and err ~= W.lastErr then W.lastErr = err; say("window draw error: " .. tostring(err)) end W.repaint() end
function W.open(force) if not ok_theme then say("The window library is not available (it comes with the Aardwolf package). The text commands work: dbg help."); return end if not (W.win and WindowInfo(WIN, 1)) then W.added = {} W.win = ThemedBasicWindow(WIN, 220, 150, 700, 420, "Plugin Debugger", "center", true, 1, function() W.safedraw() end, function() W.safedraw(); DoAfterSpecial(0.1, "dbg_win_redraw()", 12) end, function() W.win = nil; W.added = {}; if W.sb then pcall(W.sb.unInit, W.sb) end; W.sb = nil end, GetAlphaOption("output_font_name"), GetOption("output_font_height"), true) if type(W.win.menu_table) == "table" and type(W.win.menu_handlers) == "table" then -- some versions of the library have no menu table.insert(W.win.menu_table, "Close"); table.insert(W.win.menu_handlers, function() W.win:hide() end) end end local show = force if show == nil then show = not WindowInfo(WIN, 5) end if show then W.win:show(); W.safedraw() for _, t in ipairs({ 0.1, 0.3, 1 }) do DoAfterSpecial(t, "dbg_win_redraw()", 12) end else W.win:hide(); W.repaint() end end
function dbg_win_redraw() if W.win and WindowInfo(WIN, 1) then W.safedraw() end end function DBG_wheel(flags) W.top = W.top + ((bit.band(flags, 0x100) ~= 0) and 1 or -1) -- 0x100 = scrolled down if W.top < 0 then W.top = 0 end W.safedraw() end function DBG_click(flags, id) if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_lh_mouse) == 0 then return end local changed = true if id == "a_toggle" then dbg_command("", "", { on and "off" or "on" }); changed = false elseif id == "p_all" then pick = nil; clear(watch); clear(groups) elseif id == "p_none" then pick = {}; clear(watch); clear(groups) elseif id == "t_all" then clear(types) elseif id == "t_none" then clear(types); types[1] = "none" else local n = id:match("^p_row(%d+)$") if n then local name = W.names[tonumber(n)] if name then W.toggle_plugin(name) end else n = id:match("^t_row(%d+)$") if n and W.KINDS[tonumber(n)] then W.toggle_kind(W.KINDS[tonumber(n)]) else changed = false end end end if changed then SaveState() end W.safedraw() end
function dbg_command(name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local cmd, rest = arg:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") cmd = cmd and cmd:lower() or "" rest = rest or "" local lr = rest:lower() if cmd == "on" then if not on then startTrace() end return end if cmd == "off" then if on then stopTrace() else say("already off.") end return end if cmd == "watch" then if rest ~= "" then local words = {} for w in lr:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end if words[1] == "clear" or (#words == 1 and words[1] == "all") then watch, types, groups, pick = {}, {}, {}, nil else for _, w in ipairs(words) do if w ~= "all" then local ty, gr = TYPE_WORDS[w], GROUP_WORDS[w] if ty then if types[1] == "none" then table.remove(types, 1) end if not listHas(types, ty) then types[#types + 1] = ty end elseif gr then if not listHas(groups, gr) then groups[#groups + 1] = gr end elseif not listHas(watch, w) then watch[#watch + 1] = w end end end end SaveState() end say(watchText()) return end if cmd == "ignore" then if lr == "clear" then for i = #ignore, 1, -1 do ignore[i] = nil end for i = #itypes, 1, -1 do itypes[i] = nil end for i = #igroups, 1, -1 do igroups[i] = nil end else for w in lr:gmatch("%S+") do local ty, gr = TYPE_WORDS[w], GROUP_WORDS[w] if ty then if not listHas(itypes, ty) then itypes[#itypes + 1] = ty end elseif gr then if not listHas(igroups, gr) then igroups[#igroups + 1] = gr end else if not listHas(ignore, w) then ignore[#ignore + 1] = w end end end end SaveState(); say(ignoreText()) return end if cmd == "unwatch" or cmd == "unignore" then for w in lr:gmatch("%S+") do local ty, gr = TYPE_WORDS[w], GROUP_WORDS[w] local t = (cmd == "unwatch") and (ty and types or (gr and groups or watch)) or (ty and itypes or (gr and igroups or ignore)) local i = listHas(t, ty or gr or w); if i then table.remove(t, i) end end SaveState(); say(cmd == "unwatch" and watchText() or ignoreText()) return end if cmd == "noise" then local any = false for w in lr:gmatch("%S+") do any = true if w == "off" or w == "clear" then noiseOn = {} elseif w == "all" then for _, n in ipairs(NOISE) do noiseOn[n] = true end else local hit for _, n in ipairs(NOISE) do if n == w or n == "window" .. w then noiseOn[n] = true; hit = true end end if not hit then say('"' .. w .. '" is not a noise word. They are: ' .. table.concat(NOISE, ", ")) end end end local nz = {} for _, n in ipairs(NOISE) do if noiseOn[n] then nz[#nz + 1] = n end end say("Noise let through (until you change it or reload): " .. (#nz > 0 and table.concat(nz, ", ") or "none")) return end if cmd == "stock" then buildStock() local names = {} for n, v in pairs(stockCache) do if v then names[#names + 1] = n end end table.sort(names) say("stock plugins found (" .. #names .. ") = the ones the Aardwolf package's world file includes:") plain(#names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "(none found)") return end if cmd == "summary" then summary(tonumber(rest) or 10) return end if cmd == "last" then flushPend() local n = tonumber(rest) or 30 for i = math.max(1, #ring - n + 1), #ring do local ev = ring[i]; ColourNote(ev.kind == "sent" and "yellow" or "silver", "", os.date("%H:%M:%S ", ev.t) .. ev.s) end return end if cmd == "log" then if lr == "on" or lr == "off" then logging = (lr == "on"); if not logging and logfile then logfile:close(); logfile = nil end; SaveState() end say("log: " .. (logging and ("on, writing what is watched (" .. typesText() .. " in " .. whereText() .. ")") or "off")) return end if cmd == "quiet" then if lr == "on" or lr == "off" then quiet = (lr == "on"); SaveState() end say("quiet: " .. (quiet and "on" or "off")) return end if cmd == "window" or cmd == "win" or cmd == "select" or cmd == "pick" then DbgTest.W.open(); return end if cmd == "help" or cmd == "?" then dbg_help(); return end if cmd == "options" or cmd == "option" or cmd == "settings" or cmd == "status" then dbg_options(); return end say("Plugin Debugger is " .. (on and "ON" or "off") .. ". Type dbg options to see the settings and dbg help for the commands.") end
function OnPluginListChanged() stockCache = nil; if DbgTest.W.win then DoAfterSpecial(0.3, "dbg_win_redraw()", 12) end end function OnPluginInstall() watch, ignore, types, itypes = loadList("watch"), loadList("ignore"), loadList("types"), loadList("itypes") groups, igroups = loadList("groups"), loadList("igroups") logging, quiet = GetVariable("logging") == "1", GetVariable("quiet") == "1" pick = nil if GetVariable("picked") == "1" then pick = {} for w in (GetVariable("pick") or ""):gmatch("[^\t]+") do pick[w] = true end end end function OnPluginClose() if on then SetTrace(false) end; if logfile then logfile:close() end end
